_source: Frames recorded from real devices, copied verbatim from the Traccar project's public decoder tests (https://github.com/traccar/traccar, src/test/java/org/traccar/protocol/: Gt06ProtocolDecoderTest, H02ProtocolDecoderTest, Gps103ProtocolDecoderTest, TeltonikaProtocolDecoderTest, Jt808ProtocolDecoderTest; Apache License 2.0). Fetched 2026-11-02 for veh100b. Some frames were hand-edited upstream (Traccar does not check GT06 CRC / JT808 checksums), which is why our decoders flag rather than drop them. Frames longer than 300 bytes left out.
